description_for_human: Retrieves known issues, fixes, and product documentation from the engineering knowledge base (Foundry IQ on Azure AI Search)
description_for_model: Performs agentic retrieval against the acquired company's product engineering knowledge base, a Foundry IQ knowledge base hosted in Azure AI Search. Use this plugin to look up known issues, root causes, fixes, release notes, troubleshooting guides, and product documentation. Pass a clear standalone technical query in the text field of the first user message.

functions.name: retrieveFoundryKnowledge
functions.description: Retrieves relevant passages and source references from the product engineering knowledge base (Foundry IQ) for a natural language technical query about product behavior, error messages, known issues, fixes, or documentation. Returns extracted content the model should use as grounding to answer, along with references to the source documents.
